# Crew API: files (Public endpoints)

Part of the [Crew API reference](README.md).

## POST /v1/files

Upload a file for input_image / input_file.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |

The file is stored in the user's crew and belongs to this grant: only this grant can reference it in input_image / input_file, and a reference from another grant is 404. At most 20 MB. Only types the agent's input_modalities can use are accepted (images: png, jpeg, webp, gif; files: pdf, txt, md, csv, json); anything else is 422 capability_unavailable. Spends no credits but counts against the rate limit. When features.file_uploads is false, 422 capability_unavailable. Retention: stored responses (with the stream events used to resume), the event index, resolved approvals and uploaded files are all kept 30 days by default; the owner can set `crew_api.retention_days` in the crew settings to 1 to 365 days. Deleting a conversation deletes its responses and events.

Request headers:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Crew-API-Version` | string | no | The minor version the client was written for. Without it, the server answers with 1.0 behaviour. The server never refuses a request because this version is old. |
| `X-Request-Id` | string | no | A caller may supply its own; an id assigned by an intermediary in front of the gateway wins. |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | Accepted by every Public POST. Within one grant, a retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first result (the same object id) and is neither run again nor charged again; the same key with a different body is 422 idempotency_key_reused. |

|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | string (binary) | yes | One file, at most 20 MB. |
| `purpose` | `user_data` | yes |  |

Response `201`: Stored.

## DELETE /v1/files/{file_id}

Delete a file this grant uploaded.

| About | This endpoint |
|---|---|
| Status | Planned |
| Tier | Public |
| Stability | stable |
| Callers the API defines | The owner, with the owner's own sign-in. An app, with a credential that holds the scope `responses:write`. |

Only a file this grant uploaded can be deleted; others are 404. A later request that references it gets 404. An app that uploaded the wrong file of a user does not have to wait for the retention period.

Path parameters:

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `file_id` | string | yes | file_ id |
